One fake is cheap, but 226 aliases need 226 independent jump histories, and the time invested in each is the price the farm pays. The atlas check runs in the open: 226 fakes pay the full price 226 times, one honest agent pays once, and the anchor trail in the ledger makes the sparrow cost visible to everyone.
